description: Write an EARNED bridge onto an existing edge: the asymmetric reason why THIS pair of pieces is linked, written after reading both. The acceptance test: a stranger reading only the bridge knows why these two • and the sentence goes FALSE if you swap the target for any other neighbor. Templated glue will be rejected at harvest review. Bridges are directional: from_piece's side of the edge. Use the heavy dot • not the em-dash.
name: deposit_bridge
